questions.Description: Experiment on collection of blood and Preparation of Serum and Plasma.
Estimation of True glucose by Glucose oxidase (GOD) method.
Estimation of Total Protein by Biuret method.
Estimation of Blood Urea by Diacetyl monoxime – Thiosemicarbazide (DAM-TSC method)
Estimation of Total Cholesterol by modified Zak method and Sacket Method.
Estimation of Triglycerides by Enzymatic method.
Estimation of serum creatinine by Alkaline picrate method.
Estimation of serum Bilirubin by Malloy & Evelyn method.
Estimation of uric acid in blood.
